howto: Press Play to drive the city, or Time trial to race seven checkpoints through downtown.
W drives, S brakes and reverses, A and D steer; hold Space to drift and Shift to boost.
In free drive, follow the blue beam to pick up a package and the green beam to deliver it before the timer ends.
Spend cash in the garage (G) on faster cars, upgrades and new districts.
tips: Drifts pay cash: hold Space through a corner at speed.
Delivery pay grows with the distance between pickup and drop-off.
In the time trial, boost (Shift) on the straights and lift off before the turns.
R puts the car back at the start if you get stuck.
Objectives at the bottom left pay extra cash and rep.

controls.keyboard: W / S / A / D or the arrows to drive, Space drift, Shift boost, R reset the car, C camera, G garage.
controls.touch: On-screen < > steer, GAS, BRAKE, DRIFT, BOOST and a G button for the garage.

difficulty: Free drive has no fail state; delivery timers get tighter over longer routes, and the time trial is a race against your own best.

cheats.effect: Every car is in your garage (G to pick one)
Your car's top speed and acceleration go up by half

settings.quality: Graphics button on the title screen: High (shadows, SSAO, reflections) or Low

features.countdown: 3-2-1-GO before the time trial; the car is held until GO
features.position-or-lap-hud: Checkpoint 2 / 7 readout with the running time and distance to the next checkpoint
features.results-with-time: Downtown Sprint card with your time, best time and NEW BEST
features.best-time-or-ghost: Best sprint time saved with the game and shown on the title (never set with codes on)
features.tutorial: A four-step first drive (throttle, steering, drifting, deliveries) with Skip; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.restart: Restart starts the time trial over, or puts the car back at the start in free drive
features.hints: The arcade Hint gives the distance to the next checkpoint or package
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting: no screen shake, flashes or speed FOV kick
features.results: Downtown Sprint results card: time, best time and NEW BEST, with Race again or Free drive
